remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-A: Typed families and V2 consumer names are supplied. Complete consumed native input/producer/ABI contracts and reconcile the declared graph with its preparation order; family selection must not substitute an interim refusal for an original accepted case.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-B: The multiframe construction contradicts carried W8; compaction contradicts carried L-RB-1; the C1-refusal factor shortcut contradicts unconditional W3. R1-R3 completeness and original-domain correspondence remain unestablished.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-C: Container extraction and roster joins are better specified, but native key/genesis/current-head trust is not independently established, numeric canonicality remains Python-only, and P3 has conflicting executable-only versus all-file-backed coverage.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-D: False future-capacity and memory_high claims are withdrawn. No accounting/enforcement/native-cost option establishes the full target; option F is unselected and must preserve the immutable outer reservation bound.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-E: Create/GO_FORK/measure/decide/ACK/exec ordering is repaired. Exact successor event/FD/native-command authorization and the exhaustive coordinator authority inventory remain incomplete.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-F: Subject states, DDL, alternatives and replay-before-CAS improve the design. Legal/Next is not a complete product relation; actual mutation gates conflict with other sections, and replay identity omits subject_kind.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-G: Typed physical futures and first-capture recovery without handler terminal are supplied. Inactive-unit closure is an additional condition beyond the original terminal check; Never_Launched release conflicts with r3; complete post-intake and recovery-seed paths remain unspecified.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-H: Stop intent and validate-before-intake order are supplied. Kernel-read-to-spool and write-to-durable-W windows, consumer reconstruction, retained writer duplicates and post-intake/release failures are not covered coherently.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-I: Optional corroboration, typed modes and the observed exact gate inventory improve the design. J8 requires the intake event before the Join that authorizes it; namespace comparisons and native join operands are incomplete; queued fallback does not establish protected response progress.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-J: Version union, exclusive creation and no missing-state initialization are retained. Exact tool/provisioner selection, genesis/head initialization, prior-v1 migration paths and every automatic recovery state still need a consistent specification.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-K: The stage floor, dependency chain, new-scope qualifier inventory and no root-worker assignment exception are sound directions. Both sealed C-API reviews keep gate/alias closure open; the v5 sole-exception and with-prefix capture repairs are not incorporated.
remaining_gaps.V2-REQ-L: Single-acquisition Gate discipline, thread placement and callback constraints are normative. Status/cancel/recovery and declined intake can wait indefinitely behind custody or stalled protected storage; response progress and prose/twin consistency remain incomplete.

clause_remaining_gaps.01.1: V-A supplies Facts_V2 families and typed consumer names; native input, current-observation, producer and wrapper obligations are not yet complete contracts, and preparation order disagrees with the declared graph.
clause_remaining_gaps.01.2: Carried L-RB-1 keeps valid span positions; V-B.6 compacts and moves them. The declared Rebase cannot satisfy both rules.
clause_remaining_gaps.01.3: Carried W8 requires every row universe head to equal the state head; V-B.5 constructs unequal-head histories without replacing W8. W3 also contradicts the arbitrary-factor shortcut on C1 refusal.
clause_remaining_gaps.01.5: Invalid-predicate controls and valid multiframe/multibucket positives are specified. CV-B-prime/CV-R and all extra-conjunct correspondence are still unproved and the constructions are inconsistent.
clause_remaining_gaps.01.7: Canonical/B2b/B2c use retained joins and the three native command guards are correctly distinguished. Rollover now crosses EFFECT_INTENT before launch refusal/quarantine; complete root/serial recovery and accepted-case cost/outcome mapping remain open.
clause_remaining_gaps.02.1: Expected JSON containers are preserved and extraction/form parameters are supplied. Numeric canonicality is entrusted to Python and UTF8/escape/path/no-cap native semantics remain unspecified or unverified.
clause_remaining_gaps.02.2: Roster_Join is explicit, but genesis/key/head authenticity requires an independently selected trust/custody/currentness chain; self-consistent packet hashes and MACs cannot supply that premise.
clause_remaining_gaps.02.3: Crosswalk schema and operation/plan/cost/follow-up joins are proposed. Complete typed native decode, dynamic producer/caller correspondence and full costs remain open.
clause_remaining_gaps.02.4: Sampling and memory_high are no longer described as reserved future capacity. No full-domain resource enforcement/interference/cost correspondence is supplied.
clause_remaining_gaps.03.2: The sequencing error is repaired; exact event relation, FD inheritance and helper enforcement of authentic native Child_Ready remain incomplete. Kernel/OS evidence remains unmeasured.
clause_remaining_gaps.03.3: V1 and additive V2 families are retained; compatibility and accepted-case preservation are still stated lemmas with incomplete typed producer/caller coverage.
clause_remaining_gaps.04.1: M1/M2 omit a native custody-product gate, M6 excludes STOP_INTENT spooling, M8 conflicts with cancellation/helper stop, and r3 contradicts Never_Launched release. The complete Legal/Next reference is not defined.
clause_remaining_gaps.04.3: Independent subjects/subgenerations and an exclusive alternative primary key are supplied. Replay identity must include subject_kind; legal request/descriptor transitions and initial-head/state mapping remain incomplete.
clause_remaining_gaps.04.4: PR-a/PR-b and retained-result recovery distinguish the old contradictions. Full post-intake/release failure and reconstruction seed/result-state mapping remain incomplete.
clause_remaining_gaps.04.5: The physical futures are now separately typed. CLOSED_OUTER adds unit inactivity beyond the original MainPID-zero/pidfd/wait test and can obstruct the original closure/reset route.
clause_remaining_gaps.06.2: A/B/C/E/F are compared and unselected; no option proves full-domain independent-request accounting, immutable parent bounds, enforcement and costs.
clause_remaining_gaps.06.3: UNKNOWN holds and owner routes are retained, but r3/M8 and shared-lock/custody waits prevent a complete original cancel/quarantine/owner recovery progress argument.
clause_remaining_gaps.06.4: Event-loop responsiveness is improved in intent. A dedicated serialized lane blocked on protected storage or held asyncio operation ownership can still prevent protected response completion.
clause_remaining_gaps.07.1: O mapping and O-by-U cells are supplied; C/P/request/descriptor event transitions and their actual mutation gates remain incomplete and inconsistent.
clause_remaining_gaps.07.3: REOPENED: carried original Never_Launched release and PR-a require release without CLOSED_WITNESS, while r3 forbids it. Repair without weakening closure requirements for any possibly launched row.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.1: Durable stop intent precedes quiescence. M6 does not authorize required STOP_INTENT spooling, and restart does not specify reconstruction of the closed transport/consumer.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.2: Raw stdin and buffer rules are proposed. Kernel write versus durable W and kernel read versus durable spool still have unclassified uncertainty windows; writer duplicates invalidate unconditional owner-death EOF.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.3: FREEZE requires spool fsync, but durable exact P/W and detection/recovery of pre-FREEZE consumption windows are not established.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.4: CLOSED_AT_DESIGN_LEVEL: full receive/validate/report/OFD evidence precedes INTAKE and new-owner I/O. Runtime/caller/native evidence remains OPEN.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.5: The table covers more windows but post-INTAKE/new-owner failure and post-RELEASE restart, partial drain/spool and stdin progress recovery are incomplete.
clause_remaining_gaps.08.6: CLOSED_AT_DESIGN_LEVEL: full root lock roster comparison/evidence is specified while originals are retained, before ACK/intake/role use. kcmp/pidfd/flock measurements and authentic roster proof remain OPEN.
clause_remaining_gaps.09.1: J8 requires committed REQUEST_INTAKE before Join, while Join authorizes that intake. Request/transaction/reservation inputs are named in prose but not fully represented in the native Join interface; PID versus user namespace comparison is ambiguous.
clause_remaining_gaps.09.2: Provider absence no longer directly refuses; validation precedes intake by rule. Circular Join and queued-only fallback still leave accepted transfer/protected response progress open.
clause_remaining_gaps.09.3: The exact source gate list verifies. Mode-specific types improve the design, but all own-operation/transferred/historical caller operands and admission-head phases need complete contracts.
clause_remaining_gaps.09.5: Cookie/namespace/pidfd absence is optional. Declining transfer then waiting until custody returns is not an accepted-case-neutral service path for live/UNKNOWN/stalled owners.
clause_remaining_gaps.11.1: Body/gate edges are richer, but V-M.4 preparation order places S6 before S1 although S6 depends on S1; native HMAC/roster/request product dependencies and consumed interfaces remain incomplete.
clause_remaining_gaps.12.1: Exact principal keysets and selection rules are proposed. Tool keys/provisioner paths, custody initial event/head/state authentication, migration paths and all constructor/loader selection artifacts remain unfinished.
clause_remaining_gaps.12.2: No handler terminal is required for retained first capture. Inactive-unit barrier, r3 versus PR-a, recovery material previously seeded by handler_terminal, and observed/settled mappings prevent complete closure.
clause_remaining_gaps.12.4: Original K4/quarantine.resolve remain. Native mutation and actual serving progress through UNKNOWN, shared locks and unavailable custody are still incomplete.
